sidebars.body_markdown: The company plans to raise funds through an SME IPO on NSE EMERGE. The stated objects are: capital expenditure on a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; general corporate purposes; and creating a public market for the shares to enhance visibility and brand. [^drhp-p75] The lead manager is Vivro Financial Services Private Limited, and the registrar is Link Intime India Private Limited.
